name: lean-ctx
description: Context Engineering for AI Agents — 79 MCP tools, 10 read modes, 95+ shell patterns, tree-sitter AST for 27 languages. Compresses LLM context by up to 99%. Use when reading files, running shell commands, searching code, or exploring directories. Auto-installs if not present.
author: yvgude
summary_zh: 面向 AI 智能体的上下文工程工具，适合读文件、搜代码和执行命令，可大幅压缩上下文并降低令牌消耗。
